From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

Cypriot, Romanian, Italian

Colcer Restaurant sits on Ayiou Antoniou street in Kato Paphos. The logo says international cuisine, and the menu keeps that promise: Cypriot souvlaki and mixed grill, Romanian mititei, sarmale and papanași, Italian pasta and pizza, plus a few Asian and Mexican dishes. On Google, guests mention the homemade food, the Romanian dishes, the mititei and the chicken souvlaki most often; the mixed grill and the pepperoni pizza are the most popular orders.

Guests on Google write that the owner cooks and serves himself: the chips are hand-cut, the mititei take three days to prepare. Open Tuesday to Sunday from twelve noon until ten at night, Monday closed. Eat in, pick up, or order delivery through foody.

What guests say

Two of 405 Google reviews, 4.8 stars on average.

“this was one of the best meals we had on the island. the owner was kind and a hard working man, he is a waiter and the chef. food was delicious and prices are fair. 100% would recommend.”
Kaja Štritof · Google review
“We shared the bruschetta and halloumi to start, then had the Mititei with homemade chips and a burger for our mains, sharing both. Every single thing was amazing. The Mititei was packed with flavour and the owner told us it takes him three days to make it properly, which you can definitely taste. The homemade chips were unreal too. And the burger… genuinely one of the best I’ve ever had.”
Megan Murphy · Google review
